turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
How did that feel for you?
I have not had another panic attack on the train since early February.
What went through your mind then?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. I think so, yes.
What happened next?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Hannah lands on the eleventh of March and I am both relieved and anxious about it.
And how was that for you?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
What went through your mind then?
I feel guilty that I even think about putting Dad in a home.
What went through your mind then?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. Yes, it was like that.
What happened next?
Claire and I visited Oakwood nursing home and the staff were kind, but Dad refused to go inside.
What happened next?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. That is how it was.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
